title: start_run test comment falsely claims pullback-clear happens independent of the camera routing
detail: The stated rationale is wrong: run-init never clears pullback; the camera_set_default call at main.odin:972 is the sole clear. If :972 were removed, an armed pullback would survive a run start.
recommended_fix: Reword the NOTE: start_run's pullback clear IS the :972 routing call (no independent clear); optionally arm pullback=true in the start_run test and assert false to pin it.
